mapper.select: select t.id, t.name, t.job_no, t.college_id, c.name as college_name from teacher t join college c on c.id = t.college_id where t.id = #{id}
select t.id, t.name, t.job_no, t.college_id, c.name as college_name from teacher t join college c on c.id = t.college_id order by t.id desc
select id, name, job_no as jobNo, college_id as collegeId from teacher order by id desc
mapper.insert: insert into teacher(name, job_no, college_id) values(#{name}, #{jobNo}, #{collegeId})
